name: local-ollama
description: BYO-hardware: every seat runs on a local Ollama instance. No API key, no spend - `dry_run` prices this chain at $0. Swap the model names for whatever you've pulled (`ollama pull <model>`); swap `baseUrl` if Ollama (or an LM Studio / other OpenAI-compatible local runner) listens somewhere other than the default `http://localhost:11434/v1`.
